register_allreduce_hook: register the allreduce_hook as a DDP communication hook to average gradients across workers
create_fp16_compress_hook: create an fp16_compress_hook to compress gradients to float16 before allreduce and decompress back to float32
create_bf16_compress_hook: create a bf16_compress_hook to compress gradients to bfloat16 before allreduce and decompress back to float32
wrap_hook_with_fp16: wrap a custom DDP communication hook with fp16_compress_wrapper to cast gradients to float16
wrap_hook_with_bf16: wrap a custom DDP communication hook with bf16_compress_wrapper to cast gradients to bfloat16
